q28.
s3presign runner — driven twice: once immediately at startup (`RunOnce`), then continuously on a `time.NewTicker` fixed 12-hour interval (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`). This is the only background runner the server actually starts. (`server/server.go:153-174` `startBackgroundRunners`; `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-45`)

Unused-infra note: `server/runner/memopayload` exists as a `Runner` type with `NewRunner`/`RunOnce` (a batch job that rebuilds every memo's payload — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:14-72`), but the server never instantiates or schedules it — `memopayload.NewRunner` has zero references across the repo (searched 343 files) and `RunOnce` has zero callers. Only its standalone helper `RebuildMemoPayload` is used, called inline per-memo on create/update in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447` — not on any schedule.
